answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a Sybil-resistant mechanism known as Proof of Physical Location (PPL). Agents register by broadcasting a unique identifier tied to a geolocation, verified through a network of trusted nodes, akin to a lighthouse atop a basalt knoll guiding ships away from a treacherous wharf. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities would need to control a disproportionate number of geographically diverse locations, making it economically infeasible.
